learning_objective: 🎯 Meet the friendly helper words that take the place of nouns so we do not have to repeat names over and over!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: A pronoun is a super helper word! It takes the place of a noun. Instead of saying Rohan is tall, Rohan is smart, we say Rohan is tall, HE is smart.
We use He for one boy, She for one girl, and It for one animal or thing. They are the singular pronoun team!
I is for talking about yourself! We is for you and your friends together. You is for the person you are talking to. They is for a group of other people or things.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Name Eraser Game!
fun_activity.instructions: Write a sentence with your friend's name, like Priya likes apples. Now, use an eraser to rub out the name and put the correct pronoun She in its place!

quick_recap: ⭐ Pronouns are words used in place of nouns.
⭐ He, She, and It are used for just one person or thing.
⭐ We, You, and They are used for many people or things.
⭐ I is a special pronoun just for yourself!
